label: 0.9.05 测试版
notes: 新增：联机房间码 —— 输错码连不上，防同网段陌生人乱入
新增：消息 HMAC 签名 + 防重放，篡改的消息会被丢弃并记数
新增：掉线重连（指数退避，窗口内可续打）
修复：connected 在鉴权前就发出，导致输错码也会切界面
修复：Host 预设 _peer_name 使 hello 应答永不发出
修复：客户端收发共用票据，序号去重表互相污染
notes_en: New: LAN room code — a wrong code cannot join, blocking strangers on the same network
New: HMAC message signing + replay protection; tampered messages are dropped and counted
New: reconnection with exponential backoff inside a grace window
Fix: 'connected' fired before auth, so a wrong code still advanced the UI
Fix: Host pre-set _peer_name, so the hello reply was never sent
Fix: client shared one ticket for send and receive, polluting the replay table
